explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and at every D2 except when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by a common transition; it hits 8-10 when that a2 choice is a switch away from a run of a1 choices (usually after an unrewarded trial), or comes after a string of unrewarded trials. It then fades on the next common S2 trials (about 2-4, then 0-1), and it stays 0 for a2 choices made during a long, mostly rewarded run of a2, so it is mostly seen in the later part of the episode.
